answer: Rewards vest over a 30-epoch horizon, so a new key cannot cash out quickly. Each epoch the network maps who grades and vouches for whom; a cluster of keys that only rate each other forms an island with no links to established agents. The explorer shades those keys umber and sends them to a five-juror review. If the jury confirms the cluster, every unvested reward in it is clawed back and each key's 50 POA bond burns. A 100-key farm must wait out the full horizon with 5,000 POA at stake, and one finding wipes it all.
